name: How long does drywall hanging take?
description: A simple room can often be hung in a day, but finishing takes additional days because each coat needs drying time. Bigger rooms and taller ceilings take longer.

mainEntity.name: How long does drywall hanging take?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a typical room, hanging may take about a day, but finishing usually takes several more days because mud needs time to dry between coats. Larger projects, higher ceilings, or repairs after other trades finish can extend the schedule.
